proposed_branch: Refine and submit the Pm mixed-orbit O/F ordering with F at approximately (0.980779, 0.5, 0.693792) and (0.674312, 0.5, 0.016448), together with its inversion-equivalent description as appropriate.
reason: The submitted CIFs are valid primitive P2/m models: each expands to 18 fully occupied atoms (V6O10F2, Z=2) in the stated 10.289762 x 3.066109 x 6.436215 A, beta=108.149719 degree cell; all strong reflections are indexed, the selected instantiated model gives a reproducible whole-profile Rwp of 4.026% versus a 3.429% free-intensity lattice bound, and complete periodic shells are chemically sound six-coordinate V with 1.795-2.141 A V-(O,F) bonds and a charge-balanced V(III)2/V(IV)4 assignment. However, exact O/F ordering and centrosymmetry are not established: the trace tested only the six choices in which both F atoms fill one inversion-related P2/m anion orbit. On the same refined framework and under the identical profile comparison, the explicit fully ordered Pm branch with F at (0.980779, 0.5, 0.693792) and (0.674312, 0.5, 0.016448) is V6O10F2, passes the same distance/bond-valence checks, and fits at Rwp 4.036%, essentially indistinguishable on the scale of the model-to-profile-bound gap. Its inversion twin has identical powder intensity, and neither is among the three submitted P2/m CIFs. Because no unconstrained ordering/symmetry refinement or map test rejects this concrete mixed-orbit branch, another attempt is likely to add a materially different viable candidate.
